三二三我每天睜開眼第一件事就是翻遍你所有的社交賬號看你今天發了什麼動態看你拍了什麼照片看你和別人說了什麼話我會一遍又一遍地放大你的臉看你眉眼的每一個細節看你嘴角的弧度看你不經意間露出的表情我會把你發過的每一條內容都儲存下來反覆翻看反覆回味連你點贊過的內容評論過的話語我都會一條不漏地記在心裡我會順著你的關注列表一個個看過去看你關注了誰看誰又關注了你只要看到有人和你多說幾句話有人和你走得近有人對你表現出一點在意我就會渾身發緊心裡翻湧著難以控制的情緒我會一直盯著你的定位看你去了哪裡和誰在一起做了什麼事我會想象你身邊的人是不是對你笑了是不是和你靠得太近了我會在心裡把那些人都趕走一遍又一遍告訴自己你只能是我的三二三你不知道我有多在意你不知道我每天花多少時間盯著你的身影不知道我把你的生活拆解得有多細緻你的喜好你的習慣你的作息你的行蹤全都被我牢牢掌握在眼底你以為你的生活是自由的是無人知曉的可其實從早到晚從白天到黑夜我都在默默地看著你看著你走路看著你吃飯看著你工作看著你發呆看著你和別人交談我會記住你說過的每一句話記住你不經意間流露的情緒記住你討厭什麼喜歡什麼我會在心裡一遍又一遍地描摹你的樣子把你刻進骨子裡刻進腦海裡誰也搶不走誰也碰不到你只能屬於我只能被我看著只能被我放在心尖上牢牢攥著不管你走到哪裡不管你做什麼我都能看到你都能感受到你都能把你的一切盡收眼底你別想躲開別想逃離別想擁有屬於自己的空間你的所有所有都該是我的都該被我看著被我佔有被我牢牢鎖在我的視線裡直到永遠需要我幫你潤色一下這段文案讓他看起來更加毛骨悚然嗎？

守密人你好：
       弥萨格大学校务处将于7月27日18:50(UTC+8) 进行校内设施修复，更新完成后您将得到通知，重新进入游戏。对于更新可能给大家带来的不便，我们会准备一份补给物资以示歉意。祝大家调查顺利！ 
  
【补给物资】
在线维护补偿：银芯×50
  
【领取条件】
领取时间截至2026年8月10日23:59。请记得及时前往邮箱领取补给物资哦。  
 
【更新内容】
一、活动
【聚灵演练】
● 唤醒体试玩关卡「鲸落」中，守密人的生命提升至原来的 200%。

二、问题修复
【故事】
● 唤醒体
    ○ 修复了唤醒体「蚀灭·萝坦」的生日显示错误的问题。
    ○ 修复了唤醒体「蚀灭·萝坦」的立绘显示偏移的问题。
● 本地化
    ○ 繁体中文
        ■ 修复了部分钥令和技能描述中，效果数值未能正确显示的问题。
    ○ 英语
        ■ 修复了活动「利维坦的游戏」中，造物「鲸骸之铠」相关战斗术语「战意」、「狂之骨」、「伤之骨」、「剑之骨」在不同界面措辞不统一的问题。
        ■ 修复了唤醒体「蚀灭·萝坦」解锁启灵 2 后，「防御」的卡牌描述中术语「长刃·陨」翻译错误的问题。
        ■ 修复了命轮「向上坠落」的词缀「消耗」翻译错误的问题。
        ■ 修复了命轮「狂乱」的名称显示错误的问题。
    ○ 韩语
        ■ 修复了唤醒体「蚀灭·萝坦」的部分技能描述未能正常显示为人工翻译的问题。
        ■ 修复了部分界面中的文本错误地显示为机器翻译的问题。

【战斗】
● 通用
    ○ 修复了非「原初·混沌」界域中「双发钥令」状态不生效的问题。
● 唤醒体
    ○ 混沌界域
        ■ 修复了持有「维度影像·蚀灭·萝坦」时，「茉夏」的「人间爆破」会错误地将追击「冥刃追灭」置入手中的问题。
        ■ 修复了「蚀灭·萝坦」技能「短刃·噬」的升级信息预览中，「力量」错误显示为「偷取力量」的问题。
        ■ 修复了「蚀灭·萝坦」在持有「巨剑·鲸落」时，通过密契「扭曲双子·黑」和命轮「挣脱锁链之日」获得的指令卡未能变化为「蚀灭」的问题。
        ■ 修复了「蚀灭·萝坦」技能「长刃·陨」在拥有生效 2 次的效果时，若合成了「巨剑·鲸落」，未能生效 2 次的问题。
        ■ 修复了「蚀灭·萝坦」的指令卡在「自动战斗」中的优先级错误的问题。修复后「长刃·陨」的优先级降低。
        ■ 修复了队伍包含「繁育·血肉」界域时，「蚀灭·萝坦」超限爆发获得的力量低于预期的问题。
    ○ 深海界域
        ■ 修复了「庞托斯」狂气爆发在未击杀敌人时，通过其它途径击杀敌人后，也会错误地获得「囚魇」的问题。
● 命轮
    ○ 修复了命轮「天之陨」在未释放狂气爆发结束战斗时，下场战斗无法正常叠加层数的问题。
● 关卡
    ○ 修复了在「调查行动」第二部第 5 章中激活共鸣点后，队伍状态栏会错误地出现 1 层的未知状态的问题。
● 相位对弈
    ○ 尝试修复了某些情况下在对战开始或断线重连时手牌为空的问题。

**V2.5.3.1 Online Maintenance Announcement**

Dear Keeper,
The Mythag Administration Office will conduct campus facility maintenance on  July 27, 2026 at 18:50(UTC+8) . You will be notified once the update is complete and you can re-enter the game. As an apology for any inconvenience caused by the update, we will provide a supply package. Wishing everyone a successful investigation!
   
[Compensation]
Online Maintenance Compensation: Silver×50
   
[Claim Conditions]
The claiming time ends on August 10, 2026 at 23:59. Please remember to go to your mailox in time to claim the supply materials.
   
[Update Content]
I. Event
[Team Trial]
● In the Awakened Trial Stage "Whale Fall," the Keeper's HP is boosted to 200% of its original value.

2. Bug Fixes
[Story]
● Awakener
    ○ Fixed an issue where the birthday display for the Awakener "Lotan: Cetarchon" was incorrect.
    ○ Fixed an issue where the portrait of the Awakener "Lotan: Cetarchon" was displaying with an offset.
● Localization
    ○ Traditional Chinese
        ■ Fixed an issue where Effect values were not displaying correctly in some Posse and Skill descriptions.
    ○ English
        ■ Fixed an issue in the event "Leviathan's Game" where the combat terms related to the Relic "Armor of Whalebone" — "Battle Intent", "Bone of Fury", "Bone of Agony", and "Bone of Blades" — had inconsistent wording across different interfaces.
        ■ Fixed an issue where, after the Awakener "Lotan: Cetarchon" unlocked Enlighten 2, the term "Long Blade: Perish" was incorrectly translated in the Card description of "DEF".
        ■ Fixed a translation error with the Affix "Consume" on the Wheel of Destiny "Falling Upward".
        ■ Fixed an issue where the name of the Wheel of Destiny "Frenzy" was displaying incorrectly.
    ○ Korean
        ■ Fixed an issue where certain Skill descriptions for the Awakener "Lotan: Cetarchon" were not displaying human translations correctly.
        ■ Fixed an issue where text in certain UI screens was incorrectly displayed as machine-translated content.

[Combat]
● General
    ○ Fixed an issue where the "Dual Posse" State was not taking effect in non-"Primordia: Chaos" Realms.
● Awakener
    ○ Chaos Realm
        ■ Fixed an issue where, while "Dimensional Image·Lotan: Cetarchon" was In Hand, Mouchette's "Mortal Blast" would incorrectly place the Pursuit "Blade of the Underworld" into hand.
        ■ Fixed an issue where "Strength" was incorrectly displayed as "STR Steal" in the Upgrade info preview of "Lotan: Cetarchon"'s Skill "Short Blade: Devour".
        ■ Fixed an issue where "Lotan: Cetarchon," while In Hand "Great Blade: Whalefall," failed to have its Command Cards transformed into "Cetarchon" cards when obtained through Covenant "Twisted Twins: Black" and Wheel of Destiny "Chains Unbound."
        ■ Fixed an issue where the Skill "Long Blade: Perish" of "Lotan: Cetarchon" failed to trigger twice when the Effect to activate twice was active and "Great Blade: Whalefall" was synthesized.
        ■ Fixed an issue where the Command Cards of "Lotan: Cetarchon" had incorrect priority during "Auto Battle". After the fix, the priority of "Long Blade: Perish" has been lowered.
        ■ Fixed an issue where the Strength gained from "Lotan: Cetarchon" Over-Exaltation was lower than expected when the team included the "Propagation: Caro" Realm.
    ○ Aequor Realm
        ■ Fixed an issue where "Pontos" Exalt could incorrectly grant "Thrall-Gaunt" after killing an enemy through other means without the Exalt itself landing the Kill.
● Wheel of Destiny
    ○ Fixed an issue where the Wheel of Destiny "Cetus Occasus" could not properly stack stacks in the next battle when the battle ended without Unleashing Exalt.
● Stage
    ○ Fixed an issue in Chapter 5 of Part 2 of "Investigation" where activating a Resonance point would incorrectly display 1 stack of an unknown State in the party status bar.
● Traphase
    ○ Attempted to fix an issue where the Hand was empty at the start of a match or upon reconnecting.
